title: ToV Principles
slide_intent: Give writers a short set of judgments to apply when someone reads a checkout message. The language should be easy to follow, give the reader agency and communicate expertise without condescension.
strategic_value: Bolt can use three shared qualities to review writing across different points in the checkout experience.
demonstration: Three stacked panels name Effortless, Empowering and Expert (without ego). The parenthetical qualification appears in a lighter weight than Expert.
practical_value: Review a proposed line of copy against each of the three principles, including the qualification attached to expertise.

content_islands.name: Section rail
content_islands.spec: Place the wordmark at the top of the dark rail, highlight the current topic in the navigation and set the small folio at the foot.

content_islands.name: Introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and one short introductory paragraph in the white column beside the rail.

content_islands.name: Principle cards
content_islands.spec: Stack three equally wide dark cards. Place the small blue numbered principle label above a large white name. Reduce the weight of the parenthetical words on the last card.
